d:
I wasn't expecting this to be uploaded so quickly after it came out, so it took me by surprise. More WakaLOVE is always good, but why did it need to be a dream ending? I'm here for escapism, not to be reminded that this is a fantasy and I'll never have anything like it in real life. Oh well. It was still very cute. Even if it is a dream, it was nice seeing Sensei reciprocate and see Wakamo directly drooling over being Sensei's wife.
